lemma card_reindex_of_bijective (t : TileSet ps ιᵤ) {f : ιᵤ' → ιᵤ} (hf : Bijective f) :
    (t.reindex f).card = t.card

name: DiscreteTiling.TileSet.card_reindex_of_equivLike
statement: @[simp] lemma card_reindex_of_equivLike (t : TileSet ps ιᵤ) (f : E) : (t.reindex f).card = t.card

name: DiscreteTiling.TileSet.card_smul
statement: lemma card_smul (g : G) (t : TileSet ps ιₜ) : (g • t).card = g • (t.card)

name: DiscreteTiling.TileSetCard.coe_inf
statement:
lemma coe_inf (t₁ t₂ : TileSetCard ps) :
    (t₁ ⊓ t₂ : TileSetCard ps) = (t₁ : PlacedTile ps → Cardinal) ⊓ ↑t₂

name: DiscreteTiling.TileSetCard.coe_inj
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast] lemma coe_inj {t₁ t₂ : TileSetCard ps} :
    (t₁ : PlacedTile ps → Cardinal) = t₂ ↔ t₁ = t₂

name: DiscreteTiling.TileSetCard.coe_injective
statement:
lemma coe_injective :
    Injective (TileSetCard.tilesCard : TileSetCard ps → PlacedTile ps → Cardinal)

name: DiscreteTiling.TileSetCard.coe_mk
statement: lemma coe_mk (t) : (⟨t⟩ : TileSetCard ps) = t

name: DiscreteTiling.TileSetCard.coe_sup
statement:
lemma coe_sup (t₁ t₂ : TileSetCard ps) :
    (t₁ ⊔ t₂ : TileSetCard ps) = (t₁ : PlacedTile ps → Cardinal) ⊔ ↑t₂

name: DiscreteTiling.TileSetCard.le_def
statement: lemma le_def {t₁ t₂ : TileSetCard ps} : t₁ ≤ t₂ ↔ ∀ i, t₁ i ≤ t₂ i

name: DiscreteTiling.TileSetCard.smul_apply
statement: lemma smul_apply (g : G) (t : TileSetCard ps) (pt : PlacedTile ps) : (g • t) pt = t (g⁻¹ • pt)
